title: MERIT: Experience-Guided Memory for Long-Horizon Persona-Specific Persuasive Dialogue
abstract: arXiv:2611.29679v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective long-horizon persuasion in recurring goal-oriented settings requires more than factual memory: it must track how a user's trust, negotiation behavior, and strategic receptiveness evolve across interactions. Existing persuasive dialogue systems are largely single-session, static, and unimodal, while cross-session memory systems, though temporally aware, retain only factual content and overlook persuasion-specific dynamics. We propose MERIT (Memory-augmented Experience-Rationale for Iterative Temporal persuasion), which pairs a graph-based memory of four persuasion-specific memory types with a per-persona experience rationale library that records which strategies succeed for each user and why. Together they enable adaptive persuasion through prompt composition alone, with no parameter updates. translated_title: MERIT：面向长周期特定人设说服对话的经验引导记忆
translated_abstract: 在反复出现的以目标为导向的场景中实现有效的长周期说服，不仅需要事实性记忆：还必须追踪用户的信任、谈判行为和战略接受度如何随互动而演变。现有的说服性对话系统大多是单会话、静态且单模态的，而跨会话记忆系统虽然具备时间感知能力，却仅保留事实内容，忽视了说服特有的动态变化。我们提出了MERIT（面向迭代式时间说服的记忆增强经验推理），它将基于图的四种说服特定记忆类型与每个人设专属的经验推理库相结合，记录哪些策略对每个用户有效及其原因。两者结合，仅通过提示组合即可实现自适应说服，无需任何参数更新。为支持这一场景，我们引入了PERSIST（基于人设的长期保险交互）数据集，包含60个精心策划的人设，涵盖……
tldr: 该论文提出MERIT系统，通过结合图结构的说服专用记忆与每个人设的经验推理库，仅凭提示组合即可实现无需参数更新的跨会话自适应说服对话，并推出了PERSIST人设保险交互数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MERIT, which pairs graph-based persuasion-specific memory with per-persona experience rationale libraries to enable adaptive cross-session persuasive dialogue through prompt composition alone—without parameter updates—and introduces the PERSIST dataset.
